brief: A soldering station for my bench: a holder for the iron while it is switched on and hot, plus two bins for solder and spare tips.
costSource: token-equivalent at Muse Spark Open shared rates, info only: the Dedicated Endpoint bills GPU seconds while up (.spend/modal-dedicated.jsonl)

requirements.requirement: Holder for soldering iron while switched on and hot
requirements.evidence: No holder added - 3D-printed Hex Cluster plastic is not heat-resistant and configurator only checks fit/collision, not heat safety. A hot iron would melt plastic and create fire/burn hazard; safe holder must be ceramic/metal, purchased separately.

requirements.requirement: Two bins for solder and spare tips (bench soldering station)
requirements.evidence: Three-cell base (piece:0,0,0; piece:-1,0,0; piece:1,0,0) with bins: bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full and bin:1,0,0~hex-bin-full for solder reel, and bin:-1,0,0~hex-bin-full-div2 with two compartments for tips/small parts. Props show use: solder-reel, tweezers, spare tips hardware.

finish.summary: Built 3-cell bench base with two bins for solder and tips (left div2 bin provides two compartments, right and center full bins). Declined the hot-iron holder: Hex Cluster parts are 3D-printed plastic with no heat rating - cannot safely hold a powered, hot soldering iron. Use a dedicated metal/ceramic iron stand alongside this storage station.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.

events.text: Your soldering bench needs a hot-iron holder — and safe heat-proof storage won't come from plastic. I'll build you the two accessory bins while leaving the heated holder out for safety.
I can't 3D-print a heat-safe cradle for a live soldering iron — so I'll set up a safe accessory station instead with dedicated bins for your solder and tips.
